newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY ORDERS LAZIO'S CRAGNOTTI TO STAND TRIAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY ORDERS LAZIO'S CRAGNOTTI TO STAND TRIAL.

text.p: Sergio Cragnotti, majority shareholder of Italy's Lazio soccer club, has been ordered to stand trial along with his daughter and a business associate on charges of accounting irregularities, judicial sources said on Wednesday.
A judge who remanded the three ruled that the trial would start in Rome on Novembr 28.
The accusations are related to the books of the first division club's newly-opened training ground, a business known as the "Lazio Sporting Centre," at Formello on the outskirts of Rome.

Cragnotti is accused of accounting irregularities connected to the building of the training complex. His daughter Elisabetta, who is Lazio managing director, is accused of tax irregularities, the Italian news agency Ansa reported.
The third defendant at the trial will be Giancarlo Novelli, a constructor who built the training complex, Ansa reported.
